## Activity

During November 2024, North City Eye Clinic recorded 563 captures. This represents the month’s completed imaging activity at the site. The activity figure provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes together, and supports monitoring of the service’s routine performance over the reporting period. No further activity figures are reported here.

## Image quality

Of the images captured, 9 sets were assessed as ungradable. This was an ungradable rate of 1.6 per cent of all captures. The result identifies the proportion of examinations for which the available images could not be used for grading. Image quality therefore remained a distinct component of the monthly review, alongside the number of captures completed and the grading outcome.

## Grading

Grading identified 140 referable results during the month. The median lag between image capture and completion of grading was 6 days. This provides the central measure of the time taken from photography to a grading decision. Taken together, the grading figures record both the volume of referable results and the timeliness of the process. Staff raised no new equipment faults during November 2024.
